Rapier / 100 designs

Recognizable slim straight needle-point rapier with narrow blade, elaborate swept/basket metal hand guard, one-hand grip and small pommel. Keep the visible basket/swept guard across all paths. Light fencing weapon, never a broad cleaver.

Each row is one path. T1–T5 describe the visual stage within that path. Click artwork for a larger preview. Thumbnails are embedded when exports are present, so the finished browser travels with the native engine documentation.
